_readme: Findings from a dossier sweep that were reported, checked, and DELIBERATELY NOT CHANGED.
Same idea as AFFORD_OK in tools/afford-audit.mjs: an instrument that cannot be told 'yes,
we know' spends every future run re-reporting the same judgement calls, and its operator
learns to skim it. Every entry carries a reason and who ruled. A reviewer is handed this
file with their batch and told these are settled — anything NOT in here is fair game.
Add an entry only for a real finding that was considered and kept. Never use it to bury

accepted.subject: Candy
accepted.finding: She is thirty-eight, yet Bert ran her bars for twenty years and Bee says twenty years on the soi.
accepted.reason: Kept. Thirty-eight with twenty years on the soi means she started with one bar at eighteen and built the rest, which is a better fact about her than a rounder age would be, and it is why a man in his sixties works for her.

accepted.subject: Candy
accepted.finding: Two Bert lines had the Stinky as a former Candy bar; three others plus Tan give it to the Ohio owner with Candy holding a quiet piece.
accepted.reason: Resolved in prose rather than accepted: she never owned it outright, she ran it. Bert's two lines now say 'since Candy ran the place'. The Ohio owner and her silent minority stand, and the white_dish arc is unaffected.

accepted.subject: Kwan
accepted.finding: She calls Nont her brother; his upbringing and Duangjai's 'my family is one son' say he has no sister.
accepted.reason: Deliberate and must not be reconciled. She says brother to a customer because a woman on this soi does not hand a farang a man, and because 'brother' is what the girls call the boyfriend when the farang is listening. Nont's own 'Brother. She said brother?' is the joke. A note sits above her entry in world.js.

accepted.subject: Nigel
accepted.finding: He says Neil is 'out at the lake, still' and also that nobody has seen him since.
accepted.reason: Refuted, not accepted: the first node is gated on neilStory and precedes the second, so only one is ever reachable on a given night.

accepted.subject: Bee
accepted.finding: Candy calls her 'my Sang Som girl at Myth Night' while she works Candy Bar 2.
accepted.reason: Refuted: Candy Bar 2 is IN the Myth Night region, so Candy is naming the district her second bar stands in, which is how anybody in this town gives directions.

accepted.subject: Bob
accepted.finding: A bar called Succubus is said to be named for his wife Kinnaree.
accepted.reason: Refuted by the next clause of the same line: 'Bar's named for her. She thinks that's vulgar. She's probably right.' The joke is the point and the prose already lands it.

accepted.subject: Rob
accepted.finding: He names his ex-brother-in-law Nong, which is also a hostess at the Gold Rush.
accepted.reason: Kept. Nong is an ordinary Thai term for a younger sibling and one of the commonest nicknames in the country, so two men and a girl can carry it. The tap collision is already closed — Nong is in _WORD_NAME_NPCS, so she only decorates in her own room.

accepted.subject: Gavin
accepted.finding: wdg_flip declares reward money:0 while Gavin's line says (+฿2000).
accepted.reason: Refuted: the ฿2000 is paid by the dialogue node's own fx, not by the quest reward, which is why the record reads zero. The money really moves.

accepted.subject: Rose
accepted.finding: The quest told the player to TELL Rose, and TELL is not a verb here.
accepted.reason: Half-refuted, then fixed: TELL already gave a voiced refusal naming ASK, so nobody was stranded, but the desc now says ASK ROSE ABOUT CANDY, which is also tappable.

accepted.subject: The Box
accepted.finding: rabbit_heist is described and equipped for the box path alone while its doneFlag is set by all three routes.
accepted.reason: Refuted, and a TOOL gap rather than a prose one: the quest carries per-route descBy entries for the operator and the kid, which the pivot was not printing. It prints them now, so the next reviewer sees all three instructions.

accepted.subject: Wayne
accepted.finding: Wayne's silent partner carries every one of Tan's identifying details while the narration files the arrangement under White Dish.
accepted.reason: Deliberate. The resonance is the point of the nominee arc — the reader is meant to half-recognise him — and canon puts White Dish on the paying side of Tan, which is exactly why the narrator's flat attribution is what a farang would assume and get wrong.
